intended_object: The standard coordinate basis e_0,…,e_n of the first isotropic summand W ≅ M = ℚ^{n+1} of the split odd quadratic space (M* × M) × ℚ, which is the space used for the type-B_{n+1} spin carrier. Inferred from the docstring, the module documentation, and how the basis is used later to build the spin representation and the exterior lattice.
explanation:
The definition is a local shorthand: `splitOddBasis ℚ (n + 1)`. The general `splitOddBasis K n` is defined for any commutative ring K. It transports `Pi.basisFun K (Fin n)` to the summand W = (⊥ × ⊤) × ⊥ along the evident linear isomorphism. A lemma in the library (`coe_splitOddBasis`) shows that its i-th vector is ((0, Pi.single i 1), 0), which is exactly the coordinate basis of the M-axis.

Fixing K = ℚ and rank n + 1 is not too narrow. It is the defining setting of this file: a specific carrier whose rational spin module contains an integral lattice, from which the ℤ-group scheme is built. The general version already exists in the library as `splitOddBasis`, so this abbrev just names that object in the one setting the file uses. It matches its docstring and contains no error.
